display.purpose: Slide titles and major thematic numbers.

label.purpose: Terminal output, metadata, and structural annotations.

components.name: Solid Panel
components.description: Grounded content blocks and structural content zones.
components.css: .ds-solid-panel { background: #F3F3EF; color: #111111; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(17, 17, 17, 0.1); border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Floating metadata cards over dark or textured backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-glass-panel { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); color: #ffffff; padding: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); }

narrative.overview: This system represents a technical, editorial, and highly structured presentation aesthetic. It leans into architectural precision, combining Swiss-style typography with code-centric monospace elements. The layout relies heavily on strict grid systems, wireframe-like borders, and purposeful whitespace to convey engineering rigor. It explicitly rejects SaaS marketing tropes, soft gradients, and generic decorative illustrations.
keyCharacteristics: Extreme typographic hierarchy (massive display text vs. strictly 24px mono annotations).

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: The palette is limited to these four colors. Gradients are only used as subtle radial dot-patterns for background texture, never as color transitions on UI elements.

rules.name: The 24px Minimum Rule
rules.body: No text on any slide may be smaller than 24px. Hierarchy must be established through scale (going larger) and font-weight, never by shrinking text below the baseline.

rules.name: The Structural Line Rule
rules.body: Depth is secondary to structure. Use 1px borders of prussian/20 or dark/10 to delineate zones before resorting to shadows.

dos: Do use strict grid alignments and visible 1px borders to separate content areas.
Do uppercase monospace fonts for small labels, eyebrows, and metadata to give a technical feel.
Do ensure all body text is at least 24px.
donts: Don't use SaaS landing-page clichés like neon gradients, bubbly 3D icons, or soft pastel illustrations.
Don't mix multiple vibrant accent colors; stick to Prussian Blue as the sole highlight.
Don't use border radii on structural layout elements; save them for specific floating panels or UI abstractions (like the terminal).
